240-574-4742-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat from step 2.
240-574-4742-5470.notes: Depending on how many counters this combo puts on Vish Kal, you can activate its last ability to kill some number of creatures.

391-765-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Blossom Dryad doesn't have summoning sickness.
391-765-2645-3430.description:
Activate Guildless Commons by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Guildless Commons
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Blossom Dryad.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7607.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X land card(s) in all graveyards
728-6972-7607.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Centaur Vinecrasher.
When Centaur Vinecrasher dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2445-7741.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

1778-2459-4973-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1778-2459-4973-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1809-1987-2427.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-2427.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-2427.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7673-7674.description:
Cast Arachne for its web-slinging cost, tapping Spider-Man to convoke the spell through Eirdu and then returning Spider-Man from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Spider-Man for its web-slinging cost, tapping Arachne to convoke the spell through Eirdu and then returning Arachne from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3062-3099-4762-5902.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Pir and Innkeeper's Talent.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2034-5003-6773-7175.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

851-1409-1780.description:
Activate Burdened Aerialist by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Burdened Aerialist enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Burdened Aerialist.
Resolve the Burdened Aerialist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1726-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Scrapyard Recombiner.
When Scrapyard Recombiner dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Scrapyard Recombiner's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Scrapyard Recombiner from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

3062-7009-7068.manaNeeded: {3}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
3062-7009-7068.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Baboon Spirit triggers, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Pir.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

uses.n: Storm the Vault // Vault of Catlacan

1174-1460-6678.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
1174-1460-6678.description:
Activate Vault of Catlacan by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning Talon Gates of Madara from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Vault of Catlacan.
Activate Talon Gates of Madara's third ability by paying {4}, putting it from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Talon Gates of Madara enters the battlefield, it triggers, phasing out up to one target creature.
Repeat.

803-4394-5231-5470.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Ghired, adding {R}.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Ghired from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

983-1987-2468-2751.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
983-1987-2468-2751.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Panoptic Mirror triggers.
Holding priority, activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Panoptic Mirror's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Panoptic Mirror's trigger, casting a copy of Ghostly Flicker without paying its mana cost.
Resolve the copy of Ghostly Flicker, blinking Temple of the False God and Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

804-2533-2921-4681.description:
Activate Loyal Retainers by sacrificing it, returning Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Karmic Guide.
When Sakashima the Impostor enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Loyal Retainers from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor.
Repeat.

2457-4365-4772-5794.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate Baylen's first ability twice by tapping the four Insect tokens, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

4050-5660-5661.description:
Cast Bond Beetle by paying {G}.
When Bond Beetle enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Bond Beetle, adding {G}.
Resolve the Bond Beetle trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Bond Beetle from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

413-2060-2577-3602.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional Zombie.
413-2060-2577-3602.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Bhaal triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
When Gravecrawler enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

5011-5256-5326.notablePrerequisites:
Cavalier of Night in exile with a takeover counter on it.
The Master on the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
5011-5256-5326.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing The Master.
When The Master dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Night.
When The Master enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, doing nothing.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to The Master's power.
Repeat.

844-951-2232-2972-3809.description:
Cast Slumbering Dragon by paying {R}.
When Slumbering Dragon enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Shivan Devastator from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Shivan Devastator by paying {1}{R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shivan Devastator enters the battlefield, Ganax and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Slumbering Dragon from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may cast Shivan Devastator for an arbitrarily large amount of mana to put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

3525-3784-4758.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3525-3784-4758.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Crossroads Candleguide by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

1479-2374-3756.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2374-3756.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it, Maja, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Maja trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Izzet Boilerworks from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters the battlefield, it and Maja trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1367-2094-4603.notablePrerequisites: Clearwater Goblet has at least three charge counters on it.
1367-2094-4603.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Clearwater Goblet triggers, causing you to gain at least three life.
At the beginning of your draw step, Maralen triggers, causing you to lose three life, then search your library for Nexus of Fate and put it into your hand.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuflle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

2024-2268-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
Dream Coat attached to any creature you control.
2024-2268-5168.description:
Activate Dream Coat by paying {0}, making the enchanted creature all colors.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{W}{G}, giving Bloom Tender +3/+3 until end of turn and untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
